about: Page text that is never a park's official name (26 Nov 2026, audit F11). Each row: a pattern (Python regular expression, case ignored, searched in the whole candidate), why, examples it must catch (real junk from the park facts) and real names it must NOT catch. The tests read this file: test_page_reader_fixes.py. A name carried by more than shared_limit parks of the same site is not a park's name either (unless it is that park's own POTA name).
